title: Tool Over-Temperature
fullDescription: Black & Decker 20V Max tools blink one LED when motor or driver thermal limit is reached.

title: Stall Protection
fullDescription: Two blinks indicate the controller cut current due to bit jam or stall.

title: Low Battery Cutoff
fullDescription: Three blinks signal the 20V Max pack reached low-voltage cutoff.

title: Charger Defective Pack
fullDescription: Solid red on LCS1620 means BMS lockout or cell failure.

title: Charger Temperature Hold
fullDescription: Red flash means LCS1620 waiting for pack to enter 0-45 C.

title: Auto Feed Spool Jam
fullDescription: Black & Decker AFS auto-feed spool fails when line is welded together inside.

title: Blower Air Door Safety Open
shortDescription: Tool will not run with door open.
fullDescription: Black & Decker blowers have an air-inlet door interlock; if not fully closed, tool will not run.

fixSteps.title: Close door
fixSteps.instruction: Press inlet door fully shut until click.

title: Mower Safety Key Missing
shortDescription: Mower will not start without key.
fullDescription: Black & Decker cordless mowers require yellow safety key in slot before starting.

fixSteps.title: Insert key
fixSteps.instruction: Push yellow key fully into slot.

title: Tool Will Not Power On
fullDescription: Bent terminals or controller failure with confirmed pack typically causes complete unresponsiveness.

fixSteps.title: Inspect terminals
fixSteps.instruction: Check tool foot for bent/burnt contacts.

title: Trigger Erratic / Stuck
fullDescription: Dust accumulation around trigger module causes stuck or erratic operation.

title: AFS spool jam
fullDescription: AFS string trimmer spool jam. Common indication on Black & Decker cordless tools. Resolve by power-cycling, checking battery contacts, or contacting service.

fixSteps.title: Clean contacts
fixSteps.instruction: Clean battery and tool contacts with dry cloth.

fixSteps.title: Test on another tool
fixSteps.instruction: Try battery in another compatible tool to isolate.

whenToCallPro: If reset doesn't fix or BMS continues to trip, warranty service may be needed.
